notes: Thresholds calibrated on 8191 pairs (LFW train + 10_folds) at FMR<=0.001.
Metrics reported on 997 disjoint held-out test pairs.
Coverage 0.9970: 3 of 1000 test pairs had a face the detector could not find. Metrics above are conditional on the pairs it did find.

The detection cascade lowers headline AUC because it stops silently discarding the hardest images. That is the metric becoming more honest, not the model getting worse; coverage rises and the pipeline answers more queries.
Flip TTA follows the published ArcFace evaluation protocol, which averages a crop with its mirror. InsightFace's own get_feat() does not do this.
LFW is a frontal, celebrity-photo benchmark; social-media media is harder.

Resolution sweep: impostor distances do NOT close as the face shrinks (0.8387 at 98px vs 0.8620 at 29px), so no size penalty is applied. What degrades is genuine separation: p97 rises 0.4669 -> 0.5220. Low resolution costs recall here, not precision.

That result is conditional on LFW impostors, which are random strangers. It cannot speak to look-alikes surfaced by reverse image search, which is the population the 0.6888 production false match came from.

Repost test: same photo after JPEG/resize reaches p99 mean error 5.6142 and dhash 0.0586; the nearest *different* photograph sits at 23.9961 and 0.2383. The shipped dhash bound of 0.04 was tighter than the same-photo 99th percentile, so it was missing genuine reposts.
